Whopper Sauce
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, February 14, 2010 - 10:09am

Ingredients




1 prt Mayonnaise
1 prt ketchup

Preparation

1 Mix well. Add pickles or onions if desired. 2 The WHOPPER sandwich is America's most preferred premium hamburger with a trademark build of lettuce, tomato, onions, pickles, mayonnaise, ketchup, and a 4-ounce flame broiled hamburger patty. There is no secret sauce. It's just mayo & ketchup. Of course with pickles and onions, it tends to take on a Thousand Island dressing kind of taste.
